name: Meeting {OS}
tagline: Meetings that produce decisions and owners, or do not happen.

commands.name: /meeting-test
commands.summary: Decide whether the meeting should exist, with its person-hour cost.

commands.name: /meeting-agenda
commands.summary: Build an agenda where every item names a decision, a decider and a time box.

commands.name: /meeting-brief
commands.summary: Assemble and circulate the pre-read, including prior decisions on the topic.

commands.name: /meeting-run
commands.summary: Run the room to decisions, parking what cannot be decided with its unblock condition.

commands.name: /meeting-record
commands.summary: Write the decision record and action items with one owner and one date each.

commands.name: /meeting-followup
commands.summary: Close or renegotiate every open action before the next occurrence.

commands.name: /meeting-audit
commands.summary: Judge a recurring meeting on evidence: keep, shrink, merge or kill.

commands.name: /meeting-decline
commands.summary: Write the refusal, naming the asynchronous alternative and its date.

requires_human_approval_for: declining or cancelling a meeting somebody else called
sending an agenda, a pre-read or a decision record to external attendees
assigning an action to a named person who was not present
recording a decision as final when the named decider has not confirmed it
killing or merging a recurring meeting other people rely on
